text: {"lessons":["Buying more after prices fell increased my exposure, but one small rebound did not show that the losses were over; I should avoid reacting impulsively to short-term moves.","I should keep enough cash for future opportunities and avoid putting too much into several stocks at once, especially when I have limited experience.","My goal is to buy an apartment within ten years, so I should judge decisions by a consistent long-term plan rather than checking the account often and chasing quick growth."]}
